scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:services" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:services: concurrently "cd backend/services/customer-service && npm run dev" "cd backend/services/order-service && npm run dev" "cd backend/services/product-service && npm run dev" "cd backend/services/inventory-service && npm run dev" "cd backend/services/payment-service && npm run dev" "cd backend/services/pricing-service && npm run dev"
scripts.build:kernel: cd backend/shared/kernel && npm install && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend/shared/kernel && npm install && cd ../../gateway && npm install && cd ../services/customer-service && npm install && cd ../order-service && npm install && cd ../product-service && npm install && cd ../inventory-service && npm install && cd ../payment-service && npm install && cd ../pricing-service && npm install && cd ../../../frontend/apps/distributor-portal && npm install
scripts.db:seed: cd backend/gateway && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend/gateway && npx prisma migrate dev
